full_judgment: 3. The defendant Nos. 1-5 contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material statements made in the plaint 1 and contending, inter alia, that the suit land belonged to Mohim and Billa Dasi such having 8 annas share. Billa Dasi settled 2.31 acres of land by a registered patta dated 10.07.1933 in favour of the Guru Charm and latter asserted that he purchased the said land in the name of Jogendra Sarder. Billa Dasi died leaving behind daughters Laxmi Dasi who sold by a kabala deed dated 22.11.1942 in favour of Guru Charan. Guru Charm purchased that land in the benami of Upendra and Gogendra Sarder. Mohim Sana sold 1.62 acres of land to Kalipada and Jotish. After that transfer Mohim had his interest in 3.11 acres of land. Guru Charm filed a Money Suit No.19 of 1944 against Ashini Sana. That suit ended in terms of compromise and that compromised an area of 1.53 acres of land was transferred in favour of Guru Charan. This way Guru Charan acquired title and possession in 6.25 acres of land. The R.S. record was wrongly prepared in the name of Ashini whereupon Guru Charan filed Title Suit No.244 of 1966 in the 3rd Court of Munsif, Khulna against Momena for setting aside that auction; that suit was decreed on compromise. Thereafter, Guru Charan got his name mutated and died leaving behind one sons named Sudhir who while in possession died leaving behind the defendant Nos. 1-5 and 4 daughters. It is asserted that the plaintiff had no title and possession in the suit land.
